sources.title: Patent Language Model Pretraining with ModernBERT - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Prior ap-proaches to patent NLP have primarily re-lied on fine-tuning general-purpose models or domain-adapted variants pretrained with lim-ited data. In this work, we pretrain 3 domain-specific masked language models for patents, using the ModernBERT architecture and a cu-rated corpus of over 60 million patent records.

sources.title: US threatens sanctions against Chinese AI models over IP theft
sources.snippet: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the U.S. could sanction Chinese open AI models over alleged IP theft, expanding the Trump administration's campaign to slow China's AI advances.
